title: I clicked a link and typed my password
family_summary: clicked a link and typed a password

steps.text: Close that page now. Don't type anything else into it.
Change the password for that account. Use the app or website you normally use, not the link.
If you typed your card details too, call your bank on the number on the back of your card.
If you use the same password anywhere else, change it there too. Your family can help you.

args.reason: Mum may need help changing passwords after clicking a link.
